pins.definition: To require something or someone because it is essential or very important.
To require something or someone because they are necessary or important.
To require something important or essential.

situation: A tired woman sits at an empty kitchen table with her head in her hands before a completely bare plate.
subject: the absolute absence of food
brief: A woman sits hunched over a wooden table, her fingers pressed against her temples in exhaustion. Before her lies a completely empty ceramic plate and nothing else, starkly illuminated against deep shadows that swallow the rest of the room.
prompt: A woman sits hunched over a wooden table, her fingers pressed against her temples in exhaustion. Before her lies a completely empty ceramic plate and nothing else, starkly illuminated against deep shadows that swallow the rest of the room. expressive charcoal and white chalk on toned grey paper, smudged tone, decisive dark accents, the paper left bare where the light falls. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.

notes: es-ES «necesitar»: To require something or someone because it is essential or very important.
de-DE «brauchen»: To require something or someone because they are necessary or important.
ru «нуждаться»: To require something important or essential.
